data.name: TeepyTime
data.detailed_description:
What is TeepyTime?

TeepyTime is a shared ambient application. When you launch it, you are represented as a glowing orb in space. Other connected players appear as orbs too, each following its own procedurally generated orbit.

What's in it

  • Real-time multiplayer — you see other players' orbs as they appear

  • Procedural orbits — each player's path is unique and deterministic

  • Ray-traced visuals with glow effects

  • No objectives, no score, no progression

  • No text chat or voice chat

Genre: Ambient / Casual / Relaxation
